scenes.say: Imagine a salesperson quotes you twenty thousand dollars for a home battery.
In twenty twenty-six, a typical ten to fifteen kilowatt-hour battery costs about ten to sixteen thousand dollars installed.
That's roughly eight hundred fifty to thirteen hundred dollars per kilowatt-hour of usable storage.
And purchased batteries installed in twenty twenty-six get no federal tax credit.
Batteries pay off fastest under net billing, with time-of-use rates, or when backup power really matters to you.
